name: canvas_note_engineer
displayName: Canvas Note Engineer — Sổ tay Kỹ sư
description: Interactive Engineering Notebook & Dynamic Architecture Knowledge Graph for DeepSeek Harness with Zero-Token caching, instant Drawer inspection, and smart pruning.
author: justpassingByte & Antigravity

tools.name: create_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Generates the initial 3-5 node root knowledge graph for a real-world software engineering problem, race condition, or architecture failure mode.

topic.description: The technical domain or failure scenario (e.g., 'Idempotency in Distributed Payment Systems')

root_problem.description: The catastrophic failure mode under high concurrency or network timeout

constraints.description: Technical constraints (e.g., ACID, Latency < 5ms, Zero Data Loss)

tools.name: expand_concept_node
tools.description: Expands 1 or 2 new connected delta nodes from an existing concept node in the knowledge graph using minimal context payload (< 350 tokens).

target_concept_slug.description: The slug ID of the node to expand (e.g. 'node-khien-khoa')

existing_node_slugs.description: Array of already existing node slugs to ensure zero duplication

expansion_intent.description: The architectural direction for the expansion

tools.name: prune_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Prunes or collapses a branch/node from the knowledge graph to prevent canvas clutter with zero token cost.

node_id.description: The node ID to collapse or delete

action.description: Action to perform on the node/branch
